item.title: New PC Build
item.description: Finally, after using the same PC build for 9 years, I have built a new desktop PC. Thanks to the community members over at Tom’s Hardware forum, I puchased the parts from this list (as of 05/2024): https://pcpartpicker.com/user/t3kg33k_og/saved/#view=zpXWrH Even though I am an avid Linux fan, I had no choice but to install Windows 11 because there is one game that I play regulary (when I have the time), and have played for a very long time, that will not work in Steam’s ProtonDB is Insurgency: Sandstorm due to the anti-cheat software it uses is only compatible in Windows.
